name: The Supreme Magister

angles.text: As a mage, you carry an arcane aura that Elaadrin recognizes. He values the rare aptitude and resolve needed to master the arcane and preserve your homeland.

faq.answer: Elaadrin Evengale leads the High Order as its Supreme Magister. From a lodge in Valanaar’s southeast, he seeks people with the arcane aptitude and resolve to defend their home.
Elaadrin Evengale and his followers work from a lodge in Valanaar’s far southeast.
faq.q: Where can Elaadrin Evengale be found?

faq.answer: The High Order is an arcane organization in Valanaar, led by Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale. Its members wield arcane power to defend their home, though their numbers are dwindling and tensions in the settlement are rising.

aliases: why do high order and windshapers fight
faq.answer: The High Order and the Windshapers are bitter rivals in Valanaar. Local leaders urge them to keep apart and prevent violence in the streets, especially with cult activity threatening the settlement.
faq.q: Why is there conflict between the High Order and the Windshapers?

faq.answer: Rathiril directs promising newcomers to the High Order in Valanaar through magical missives. These messages alert Elaadrin Evengale to people of notable potential.
A mysterious cult active around Valanaar threatens the settlement. Local authorities work to quell conflict between groups such as the High Order and the Windshapers to keep Valanaar secure.

sections.body: New arrivals of promise in Valanaar are directed to the High Order. Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale leads it from a lodge in the settlement’s far southeast. He watches newcomers closely, seeking the strength, resolve, and arcane aura to face the dangers threatening their home.
sections.title: The High Order of Valanaar

sections.body: Peace in Valanaar is fragile. The High Order and the Windshapers are bitter enemies, so newcomers are warned to keep their distance from the Windshapers lest violence break out in the streets. A dangerous cult lurks nearby. With threats outside the town, its leaders cannot afford bloodshed within.
sections.title: Rival Factions and Looming Cults

summary: In Valanaar, Elaadrin Evengale draws new arrivals toward the High Order. From a lodge in the settlement’s southeast, the order seeks allies as it faces hostile Windshapers and a nearby cult.
